proof_body:
by
  intro C _ X Y f g h hg hh
  calc g = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id Y) g := (CategoryTheory.Category.id_comp g).symm
    _ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h f) g := by rw [hh]
    _ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) := CategoryTheory.Category.assoc h f g
    _ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X) := by rw [hg]
    _ = h := CategoryTheory.Category.comp_id h
target_source: ∀ (C : Type*) [CategoryTheory.Category C] (X Y : C) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g h : Y ⟶ X), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X → CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id Y → g = h
